email_sign_in_links_session_ck.name: email_sign_in_links_session_ck

athlete_profiles_target_weight_ck.name: athlete_profiles_target_weight_ck
athlete_profiles_target_weight_ck.value: ("athlete_profiles"."target_weight" is null) = ("athlete_profiles"."target_weight_unit" is null) and ("athlete_profiles"."target_weight" is null or "athlete_profiles"."target_weight" > 0)

strength_baselines_set_ck.name: strength_baselines_set_ck
strength_baselines_set_ck.value: "strength_baselines"."source" <> 'set' or ("strength_baselines"."set_weight" is not null and "strength_baselines"."set_reps" is not null)

training_goals_priority_ck.name: training_goals_priority_ck
training_goals_priority_ck.value: ("training_goals"."status" in ('active', 'paused')) = ("training_goals"."priority" is not null) and ("training_goals"."priority" is null or "training_goals"."priority" >= 1)

training_goals_event_ck.name: training_goals_event_ck
training_goals_event_ck.value: "training_goals"."kind" <> 'event' or ("training_goals"."event_type" is not null and "training_goals"."event_date" is not null)

exercises_reps_ck.name: exercises_reps_ck
exercises_reps_ck.value: ("exercises"."rep_min" is null and "exercises"."rep_max" is null) or ("exercises"."rep_min" is not null and "exercises"."rep_max" is not null and "exercises"."rep_min" between 1 and "exercises"."rep_max")

exercises_seconds_ck.name: exercises_seconds_ck
exercises_seconds_ck.value: ("exercises"."default_seconds" is null and "exercises"."measure" <> 'time') or ("exercises"."default_seconds" is not null and "exercises"."default_seconds" >= 1)

planned_run_segments_repeats_ck.value: ("planned_run_segments"."repeat_group" is null) = ("planned_run_segments"."repeats" is null) and "planned_run_segments"."repeat_group" >= 1 and "planned_run_segments"."repeats" >= 2

planned_run_segments_measure_ck.name: planned_run_segments_measure_ck
planned_run_segments_measure_ck.value: "planned_run_segments"."distance_m" is not null or "planned_run_segments"."duration_s" is not null

planned_run_segments_pace_ck.name: planned_run_segments_pace_ck
planned_run_segments_pace_ck.value: ("planned_run_segments"."pace_min_s_per_km" is null) = ("planned_run_segments"."pace_max_s_per_km" is null) and "planned_run_segments"."pace_min_s_per_km" between 1 and "planned_run_segments"."pace_max_s_per_km"

set_prescriptions_reps_ck.name: set_prescriptions_reps_ck
set_prescriptions_reps_ck.value: ("set_prescriptions"."reps_min" is null) = ("set_prescriptions"."reps_max" is null) and "set_prescriptions"."reps_min" between 1 and "set_prescriptions"."reps_max" and "set_prescriptions"."reps_max" <= 100

set_prescriptions_load_needs_ck.name: set_prescriptions_load_needs_ck
set_prescriptions_load_needs_ck.value: case "set_prescriptions"."load_kind" when 'absolute' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" is not null and "set_prescriptions"."load_unit" is not null and "set_prescriptions"."load_basis" is null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm" is null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm_unit" is null when 'percent_1rm' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" is not null and "set_prescriptions"."load_unit" is null and "set_prescriptions"."load_basis" is not null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm" is not null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm_unit" is not null when 'rpe_based' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" is null and "set_prescriptions"."load_unit" is null and "set_prescriptions"."load_basis" is null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm" is null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm_unit" is null when 'from_e1rm' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" is not null and "set_prescriptions"."load_unit" is null and "set_prescriptions"."load_basis" is null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm" is null and "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm_unit" is null else true end

set_prescriptions_load_value_ck.name: set_prescriptions_load_value_ck
set_prescriptions_load_value_ck.value: case "set_prescriptions"."load_kind" when 'absolute' then case "set_prescriptions"."load_unit" when 'kg' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" between 1 and 500 when 'lb' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" between 2 and 1100 else true end when 'percent_1rm' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" between 0.3 and 1 when 'from_e1rm' then "set_prescriptions"."load_value" between 0.3 and 1 else true end

set_prescriptions_reference_1rm_ck.name: set_prescriptions_reference_1rm_ck
set_prescriptions_reference_1rm_ck.value: case "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm_unit" when 'kg' then "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm" between 1 and 500 when 'lb' then "set_prescriptions"."reference_1rm" between 2 and 1100 else true end

run_record_segments_measure_ck.name: run_record_segments_measure_ck
run_record_segments_measure_ck.value: "run_record_segments"."distance_m" is not null or "run_record_segments"."duration_s" is not null
